result.summary: The page is generally polished, but horizontal content is visibly clipped at the right edge and the lower restaurant card is obstructed by the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The horizontal category row extends beyond the right edge, leaving a partially visible next category chip with no clear end padding or scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Make the category carousel intentionally horizontally scrollable with consistent right padding and an affordance, or constrain/reflow the chips so no item is awkwardly cut off.

issues.description: The third card in the "Fastest near you" carousel is clipped on the right, truncating the restaurant name ("Trattoria Piccol...") and its content.
issues.suggestion: Use a clearly designed horizontal carousel with appropriate viewport padding and card width, or show complete cards in a responsive grid/list.

issues.description: The second "Popular right now" restaurant card is covered by the fixed bottom navigation; only its image top is visible and its restaurant details cannot be seen.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom content padding/safe-area inset so the final scrolling content can clear the fixed navigation bar.
